race.comment: ELECTOR (4) enjoys a class drop from his last attempt when he raced parked in a Vicbred Super Series heat at Kilmore seven weeks ago. Came from this barrier when he kicked off the campaign with a win at Wagga. Looks nicely placed. SHORELINE DREAM (9) came from this barrier when he scored a win at this circuit and distance four starts back and could be close to another success after placing in his last two outings. CAPTAINS DELIGHT (3) toughed out a win in a Breeders Challenge heat at Newcastle last start, giving her two wins and a close second from her last three starts. All of those were from tougher draws than this. Contender. TIGER EUPHEME (1) deserved last week's win following back-to-back placings and should not have any excuses from the ace draw.
